title: Identify the top 3 active charter schools (Charter = 1) with the highest av
question: Identify the top 3 active charter schools (Charter = 1) with the highest average SAT Math scores. For each school, return its name, city, charter number, and the percentage of students eligible for free meals (K-12).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_050 AS city,
    s.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
    CAST(f.XCL_020 AS REAL) / f.XCL_019 AS free_meals_pct
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Active'
  AND s.XCL_063 = 1
GROUP BY s.XCL_041, s.XCL_047, s.XCL_050, s.XCL_064, f.XCL_020, f.XCL_019
ORDER BY AVG(sat.XCL_037) DESC
LIMIT 3

    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_050 AS city,
    s.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
